verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no first-party pricing, plan, or credit-consumption documentation that would let a founder see what each action costs or what a plan includes. The only related item is a community remark that Base44 charges by the token, which shows a usage-based model but not any product capability that explains consumption or plan contents.

support.subject: As a founder, I can understand what credits or tokens each action consumes and what my plan includes
